questions.question: For the job-run workflow awaiting an agent task's completion, which control path should be primary?

options.label: Supervisor signal (Recommended)
options.description: Our slot supervisor (already in the admission loop, observes slot exit) signals the Temporal workflow directly. Multica stays mirror-only (D44 clean); CDC becomes reconciliation, poll is the fallback.

options.label: CDC-driven signal
options.description: The Postgres CDC consumer watches Multica task-state transitions and signals the workflow. Reuses the Phase-1 CDC tap as the control path — but makes a third-party DB load-bearing for control, and CDC lag delays completion.

options.label: Poll-only activity
options.description: The dispatch activity long-polls Multica REST with heartbeats until terminal. Simplest to build, no signal plumbing — but adds polling latency/load and still trusts Multica's state as the control input.

questions.question: tasks.yaml declares per-task dependencies but nothing executes them today. How should plan/task DAGs be enforced?

options.label: plan-run awaits deps (Recommended)
options.description: The plan-run workflow resolves the full task DAG: each task's dispatch step durably awaits its dependencies' completion. Matches existing practice (Phase-0 tasks already have cross-phase deps) and is cheap in a durable-execution engine.

options.label: Phases are the DAG
options.description: Intra-phase dependencies forbidden (lint error); only phase gates order work. Simpler, but contradicts the live Phase-0 tasks.yaml which already uses cross-phase deps — those would need rewriting.

questions.question: Five decided contracts have no schema files (job/v1, loop-policy/v1, activation/v1, integration/v1, usage-grain/v1) while 30 authority schemas exist. How far should this session go?

options.label: Docs + D-row now, schemas too (Recommended)
options.description: Write the Tier-1 designs into docs 18/22 with a new D-row + changelog, AND author the five missing JSON Schemas (strict-subset, matching the D67/D75 doctrine) so the audit's schema registry covers orchestration objects before Phase 1.

options.label: Docs + D-row only
options.description: Land the seam designs in docs 18/22 + the decision log now; record the five schemas as named Phase-1 build items instead of authoring them today (lighter touch while the other session is active in schemas/).
